effect_description_eng:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's 11000 DP or lower Digimon.
[All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, by playing 1 [Guilmon] from this Digimon's digivolution cards or from your trash, place this Digimon as that Digimon's bottom digivolution card.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
